_hosts: Garmin authorizes at connect.garmin.com, exchanges tokens at connectapi.garmin.com and serves the wellness API (and the ping callbacks) at apis.garmin.com, so the rewire names all three. The authorize path is /oauth2Confirm, which mockserver.py's OAuth stub answers like /authorize.
_config: the client id the push fixtures carry in garmin-client-id: garminpush refuses a push naming another app
_account: every summary type on; last7d keeps the first backfill to 15 types x 7 one-day windows
_triggers: garmin-on-connect drives the first sync, which records the Garmin user id the pushes are matched on. garmin-webhook ships disabled; the run enables it and scenario.py sets its key before posting the deliveries. garmin-on-request is the continuation. garmin-scheduled stays off.
_mockPort: fixed so the rewired function body is identical run to run (substrate#576)
